checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13, all volumes within pipette ranges (125 µL and 180 µL multi chunks, 250 µL on p1000), no well overfilled, magnet and temp modules used correctly.
Check fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact passed (48 distinct tips); a new tip per sample, per supernatant removal column and per elution column; every tip dropped.
Recovers ELUTION_VOL=100 µL into the elution plate whereas paper step 9 / rubric specify ~80 µL, so it deviates from the paper.
Check 48_samples_to_odd_columns passed; 48 tubes mapped one-to-one to wells in columns 1,3,5,7,9,11 and to distinct elution wells.
Beads 40, IPA 2x125, sample 250 with mix(5,400), delay 5 min, mag.engage + 4 min delay, then 540 µL removed to waste; checks all passed.
Two 500 µL ethanol washes each removed with magnet engaged, then 4 min delay and mag.disengage() before elution; checks passed.
Elution 100 µL mixed off-magnet and magnet 90 s are right, but recovery aspirates and dispenses 100 µL rather than ~80 µL.

judge.summary: The protocol follows the binding, wash, dry and elution sequence faithfully, and all 16 run-log checks passed. It recovers 100 µL of eluate instead of the paper's 80 µL, which fails elution_recovery and the all-or-nothing fidelity item.
